name: PermissionMatrix

props.description: Role COLUMNS in render order. `locked` keeps that role's cells read-only (with a localized lock badge) even in an editable matrix.
props.name: roles
props.type: { id: string; name: string; description?: string; locked?: boolean }[]

props.description: Permission ROWS in render order, with an optional category caption.
props.name: permissions
props.type: { id: string; name: string; description?: string; group?: string }[]

props.description: The grant relation: the grantKey(roleId, permissionId) Set from @godxjp/ui/lib/permission-grid (canonical, O(1)), or a plain pair array normalized through the same encoding.
props.name: grants

props.description: Its PRESENCE makes the matrix editable (real Checkbox cells, Space toggles). Omitted, the matrix is the canonical read-only ✓/— grid.
props.name: onGrantChange
props.type: (roleId: string, permissionId: string, granted: boolean) => void

props.description: Force the read-only grid even when onGrantChange is present (viewer permission).
props.name: readOnly

props.description: Two role ids compared side by side: their columns tint, and rows where they disagree carry a localized difference badge.
props.name: compare

props.description: With `compare`, keep only the rows the two roles disagree on (差分のみ).
props.name: diffOnly

props.description: `true` renders the built-in localized surface; a node replaces it; onRetry adds Retry to the built-in error only.
props.name: loading / denied / error / empty / onRetry

props.description: DOM id on the grid root. Worth setting on a permissions page that also renders a summary or a legend elsewhere: it is the anchor those can point at, and the stable handle for an E2E selector that must not depend on the localized `label`.
props.name: id

related: lib/permission-grid — the pure grant/diff data helpers the matrix (and any custom RBAC UI) shares.
DataTable — general tabular data with sorting/selection/pagination; PermissionMatrix is the fixed role-grid specialization with a sticky FIRST column (which DataTable cannot pin).
ServiceRolePanel — the master-detail roles surface a matrix typically renders inside.
usage: DO import it — it is a real export from @godxjp/ui/data-display (the lesson: a docs page is not importable). Never hand-compose the sticky-column grid per app.
DO keep grants in the lib/permission-grid grantKey Set form when you already hold role:permission tuples — the pair-array form exists for convenience and is normalized through the same encoding.

DO put it in a Card with CardContent flush: <Card><CardContent flush><PermissionMatrix …/></CardContent></Card>. Below its natural measure the grid scrolls horizontally INSIDE its own container (390px keeps the sticky permission column).
DO NOT encode platform roles/permissions in the library — roles, permissions and grants are consumer data by contract.
DO NOT pass compare pickers/toggles into the matrix — compose Select + Switch beside it and drive `compare`/`diffOnly` (see the showcase).
useCases: RBAC role tab on a service detail screen: read-only matrix + role compare.
Org role editor: editable matrix (onGrantChange) with the system role locked.
Permission-denied / failed read states without hand-rolling: denied / error / onRetry.
